root.en-US:
New: Added a Meter Spacing setting for the floating window, allowing upload and download speed spacing to be adjusted in horizontal layout mode.
Improvements: Updated build toolchain and dependencies for better compatibility and stability.
root.zh-CN:
新增： 悬浮窗新增“网速项间距”设置，可在水平排列模式下调整上行与下行网速之间的距离。
优化： 升级构建工具链与依赖，提升兼容性与稳定性。
